id: title:Radu-Raicea:gate taggers behind llm analytics tags end to end

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a new AI tagging capability and its associated event reporting, while also adding a feature-flag guard and removing automatic seeding of default taggers.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded capability improvement. P1.F3.H4 and P1.F4.H1 show the implementation of a new AI tagger configuration and its associated event and report, establishing a new capability for users. P1.F10.H4 adds a feature-flag guard and warning banner, providing a reliability and operational safeguard by preventing the loading of taggers before the LLM
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not show the replacement implementation for P1.F13.H1, so the removal of the entire tags/templates.ts file and its metadata is not fully explained; this removal could indicate a migration or complete removal of the feature, but without the replacement implementation, the full impact is not demonstrated. No tier assignment is performed.

observations.behavior: Adds a feature-flag guard and a warning banner to the taggers list page, and removes the automatic seeding of default taggers.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks FEATURE_FLAGS.LLM_ANALYTICS_TAGS; if false, returns a warning banner instead of loading taggers. This could prevent customers from seeing taggers before the feature is enabled, and could avoid unnecessary API calls or unintended tagger creation.
